text:
ana: Quick final triage for the Auto-Routing GA. We need a tight GA checklist: SLA writeup, public + internal docs, oncall/playbook, monitoring alerts, pricing caps, and rollback rules. Target date: next Mon.

kevin: SLA proposal: Hosted standard 99.9% (p95 <= 180ms), Hosted premium 99.95% (p95 <= 120ms). Dedicated matches but with contractual uptime. Degraded-mode: 99.0% when fallback is active for >10m. I'll draft the Confluence doc.

priya: Oncall: I own the playbook. Alerts I need: fallback_rate > 4% for 10m -> P1, error_rate > 1.5% for 10m -> P0 + auto-rollback. Will add runbook steps for triage + mitigation.

kevin: We'll emit metrics route_decision, fallback_reason, p95_latency_ms, token_cost_est. Add Grafana panel and a PagerDuty escalation for P0/P1.

miguel: Pricing/finops: suggest initial burst cap 750k tokens/day for new accounts; opt-out via Sales review. Need conservative unit-cost delta from eng by Thu for pricing page.

finops-bot: Billing template: https://git.redwood/finops/billing/pulls/999 (draft caps + notification rules).

sara: Docs: public quickstart + FAQ as one page (operational-notes). Kevin -> internal runbook + migration guide. Priya -> oncall playbook. Miguel -> pricing blurb. I'll own the announcement draft.

priya: Preflight smoke to gate CI before canary. Snippet:
```sh
# preflight
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":8}' https://api.redwood/v1/generate
# assert 200, has "choices", latency < 450ms
```

ana: Rollout: canary 2% for 8h -> 10% 12h (manual signoff) -> 30% 12h -> full. Auto-fallback to baseline model if error_rate > 2% for 15m or fallback_rate > 12% for 5m.

kevin: I'll attach microbench numbers to the release PR. Expect ~15-22% unit cost reduction with caching + batching for chat-like loads.

miguel: Will review pricing copy and confirm burst cap messaging. Also adding bill-protection: suspend heavy usage after 48h >2x baseline until Sales approves.

sara: Announcement draft done by Fri AM, will loop PM/comm for review.

priya: CI smoke will be wired into the pipeline by Fri noon. I'll post the pipeline check link.

ana: Blocking list: SLA doc, runbook PR, pricing + caps merged, CI smoke green. Owners: kevin, kevin, miguel, priya. Can we close by Fri EOD?

kevin: SLA + runbook drafts posted today.

miguel: Pricing PR in review Thu.

sara: Announcement ready Fri AM.

priya: Smoke in CI by Fri noon.

ana: If green then schedule 2% canary Mon 02:00 UTC. If any item slips, call out here and we'll cut scope. Thanks.
